# Error Handling Checklist: Capability-aware Resolver, Materializer, Installer, and Strict Override

**Purpose**: Validate that G56R-006 requirements define deterministic failure responses, rollback evidence, and preservation guarantees before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are invalid route-policy manifest states fully enumerated, including missing, unreadable, malformed, unsupported, incomplete, identity/provenance/source-roster mismatch, unknown-field, unadmitted-candidate, and unadmitted-probe cases? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001, Contract §Invalid Manifest Outcomes]
- [x] CHK002 Are discovery-unavailable and bounded-probe-unavailable outcomes specified as route-aware resolution failures without widening manifest-admitted candidates or creating a second snapshot identity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §Runtime Capability Snapshot, Contract §Failure Outcomes]
- [x] CHK003 Are all required-agent miss outcomes defined for both dry-run and apply, including complete diagnostics for all 12 required agents, zero planned/applied writes, zero helper removals, `writes_state=false`, and no restart requirement? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are strict override failure outcomes complete for required agents, including one override-derived tuple per required agent, all-agent diagnostics, zero mutation, no restart, and no preferred/fallback continuation after a miss? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are optional-helper override and no-helper failure outcomes complete, including compatible-helper install, validated no-helper continuation, unresolved no-helper pre-mutation failure, managed removal, preservation, and manual-remediation evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021-FR-025, Data Model §Optional Helper Decision]
- [x] CHK006 Are filesystem, verification, rollback-success, and rollback-failure outcomes each specified with recovery evidence and prior-install preservation semantics? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-026-FR-027, Contract §Apply failure after mutation begins]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the distinction between static compatibility failure handling and route-aware failure handling unambiguous, including absence of `data.routing` in static mode and no fallback from an invalid supplied manifest to static mode? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Static Compatibility Response, Contract §Invalid Manifest Outcomes]
- [x] CHK008 Is "zero write" defined with concrete response fields rather than a vague preservation claim? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §Recovery Record]
- [x] CHK009 Are "terminal outcome", "attempted routes", and "rejection reasons" tied to route-resolution records for every required agent in normal and strict-override modes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Route Resolution Record]
- [x] CHK010 Is "bounded probe" clear enough to constrain when a probe may run, what evidence it may add, and what it may not authorize? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Route-aware Success Response, Route Manifest Contract §bounded_probes]
- [x] CHK011 Is rollback success defined by restored bytes and modes plus matching pre/final state identities, not just by absence of an exception? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-026, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK012 Is rollback uncertainty defined with concrete fields: unrestored actions/errors, changed or uncertain `writes_state`, restart guidance, bounded manual remediation, and no verification-success claim? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-008, Contract §Failure Outcomes]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the spec, data model, and contracts consistently require exactly one fresh batch snapshot shared by all required-agent and helper decisions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §Runtime Capability Snapshot, Contract §Route-aware Success Response]
- [x] CHK014 Do the spec and plan consistently require preferred-then-ordered-fallback evaluation in normal mode and exactly one override-derived attempt in strict mode? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Design Concept Architecture Decisions]
- [x] CHK015 Do the static no-manifest requirements consistently preserve the current 13-file copy/verify response while route-aware mode uses 12 required agents plus one optional helper? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002-FR-006, Plan §Summary, Route Manifest Contract §source_roster]
- [x] CHK016 Do helper-preservation requirements consistently reject filename, location, syntactic TOML validity, parsed equivalence, or normalized content as ownership proof? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024-FR-025, Data Model §Optional Helper Decision, Design Concept §Q9]
- [x] CHK017 Do recovery requirements consistently avoid claiming verification success after failed apply, whether rollback is restored or uncertain? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-007-SC-008, Quickstart §Focused Route-aware Installer Tests]
